subject: Wire the harness-vs-hub-link sweep into a permanent check. Ad-hoc audit on 2026-08-01 found the Stage 4 capstone had both QC harnesses, a coverage-gated grader mode, and ZERO hub links -- built, gated, unreachable. The same sweep correctly showed 'wall' as a deliberately-held lab (task 251), so the check must distinguish HELD (no page, on purpose) from ORPHANED (page exists, nothing links it). Rule: a lab page that exists AND has a walkthrough-*.js harness MUST have >=1 inbound hub link. Add to _tools/eduscan/ so the next one is caught the day it lands.
